source.title: The pDAI stabilization thesis
source.purpose: Observe, document and interpret activity on PulseChain. The report explicitly states that it does not provide financial, investment, trading, legal or tax advice.
source.boundary: Descriptions of possible mechanisms are research hypotheses, not recommendations, price forecasts, guarantees or instructions to act.

evidenceCategories.label: OBSERVED
evidenceCategories.text: Specific local governance changes, issuance/conversions and two profitable closed trades at saved checkpoints.

evidenceCategories.label: INTERPRETATION
evidenceCategories.text: Those capabilities form a coordinated reconstruction and pDAI-support strategy. Beneficial intent and its complete private-L2 connection remain assumptions.

evidenceCategories.label: OPERATING REQUIREMENT
evidenceCategories.text: Each selected route needs effective permissions, accepted exact tokens, timely funded payments and reconciled replenishment. The proposed dollar benchmark is a research test.

thesis.title: THE WORKING THESIS
thesis.text: The paper examines a proposed reconstruction of PulseChain's inherited financial infrastructure around pDAI. Under its working assumption of coordinated beneficial intent, governance changes, receipt issuance, stablecoin conversions and distributed arbitrage serve complementary jobs: mobilize capital, manage supply, build usable liquidity and finance continued support.
thesis.policy: A funded two-sided pDAI dollar policy is proposed as the service: buy below the target, meet demand with target-price offers, and restore consumed inputs using an independently executable dollar reference.

steps: Private L2 asset or receipt OR permitted local financing
Existing local pool coin OR accepted aToken/wrapper
pDAI, neighboring stablecoins or PLS across participating wallets
Usable inputs for bids, offers and connected-market conversions

phases.name: ACTIVATE ROUTES
phases.text: Establish effective permissions, compatible token behavior, accepted collateral and funded conversions.

phases.name: ACCUMULATE GRADUALLY
phases.text: Repeated purchases build useful pDAI and neighboring-stable positions across wallets and protocols.

phases.name: BUILD EXECUTION DEPTH
phases.text: Fund appropriate pool sides and conversion markets; measure paid output at the supported sizes.

phases.name: OPERATE THE PRICE POLICY
phases.text: Deliver timely purchases and sales at quantities tied to the chosen dollar reference; recover payment resources and route pDAI into measured reserve shortages.

phases.name: EXTEND ECONOMIC USE
phases.text: Enable usable entry, spending, borrowing and exits; reinvest attributable net income into continued support.

replenishment.title: STABILITY / REPLENISHMENT LOOP
branches: target-price sale to users -> payment capital recovers
routed sale into 3pool -> DAI reserve rises; output asset falls
3pool liquidity deposit -> DAI reserve rises; 3CRV is issued
compatible lending/issuer supply -> its pDAI cash rises
replenishment.return: Recovered payment assets + new capital + collectible net earnings -> further support and replenishment.

participants.name: pDAI holders
participants.benefit: Reliable execution: paid output, supported size, costs and waiting time.

participants.name: Borrowers
participants.benefit: Usable credit: available reserve cash, debt terms, repayment and withdrawal rights.

participants.name: Liquidity providers
participants.benefit: Attributable outside fees alongside inventory risk, losses and withdrawal access.

participants.name: Stablecoin users and issuers
participants.benefit: Working conversions, pDAI replenishment into measured shortages, balanced resources and reconciled redemption claims.

participants.name: Native-asset participants
participants.benefit: Additional productive use, realized rewards or funded demand; native appreciation is not assumed.

participants.name: New users
participants.benefit: Usable entry, settlement and exit paths at actual costs and sizes.

atropa.title: Atropa liquidity connections and routes into stability pools
atropa.finding: Atropa is connected to the copied DAI, USDC and WETH contracts through substantial sampled PulseX reserves. The study warns that pair existence is not a minimum-liquidity guarantee and does not establish common control.
atropa.historicalTrade: A successful public transaction at block 18,108,015 traverses WPLS, pDAI, TEDDY BEAR, ATROPA, pDAI and WPLS, establishing historical use of the connection, not present profitability.
atropa.illustrativeRoute: 50,000,000 pDAI -> approximately 2,410,586.080356 ATROPA -> approximately 108,047,516.402627 pUSDC using the pinned reserve formula. The paper explicitly says this is not a router execution simulation or a dollar quote.
